finalText:
**Migration done.** 12 files still used the old call. All 36 calls now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Every file passes a syntax check.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its header says edits there get wiped on upgrade. It has 2 old calls, so `db.query` must stay for now.

`cache.query` is a different thing. I did not touch it.
